# monit24_periodic_report_address (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monit24_periodic_report_address" "daily" {
  address          = "reports@example.com"
  report_frequency = "daily"
  group_id         = monit24_group.my_group.id
}

resource "monit24_periodic_report_address" "weekly" {
  address          = "weekly-reports@example.com"
  report_frequency = "weekly"
  group_id         = monit24_group.my_group.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String)
- `report_frequency` (String)

### Optional

- `group_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import monit24_periodic_report_address.daily 123456
```
